name: Repeat
description: Sends the same value a number of times, counting as it goes, then done. Max's uzi.
vue:
<template>
  <v-card :width="width" density="compact">
    <v-card-title class="text-body-2 py-1"><v-icon size="small" class="mr-1">mdi-repeat</v-icon>Repeat</v-card-title>
    <v-card-text class="py-1">
      <v-text-field density="compact" variant="plain" type="number" hide-details label="how many times" v-model.number="times"/>
    </v-card-text>
  </v-card>
</template>
<script>
export default {
  props: { node: Object, state: Object },
  data() { return { width: 220 }; },
  computed: { times: {
      get() { const d = this.node && this.node.data; return d && d.times !== undefined ? d.times : 4; },
      set(v) { if (!this.node.data || typeof this.node.data !== "object") { this.node.data = {}; } this.node.data.times = v; },
    }, },
};
</script>
